blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – Cloud seeding operations in Bohol province generated light to moderate rains over the weekend, benefiting at least 11 localities, the Provincial Agriculture Office (PAO) said. In a report, the PAO said Saturday’s (Nov. 7) cloud seeding operations brought rainfall to areas where most of the province’s agricultural lands are located. “The operation is part of the continuing efforts to enhance rainfall occurrence and help mitigate the effects of prolonged dry conditions, particularly in agricultural areas,” it said.
